title: 關於 Angie
description: Art Center 畢業,曾任 Disney、Zynga 資深概念設計師;現為胡創有限公司負責人,專注亞洲與國際的圖像代理授權,並用 AI 打造實用工具。
description_en: Art Center graduate and former senior concept designer at Disney and Zynga; now founder of Hu Creates, focused on art & IP licensing between Asia and the international market, and building practical AI tools.

blocks.body:
我是 **Angie Hu**。

畢業於洛杉磯 Art Center College of Design 設計藝術中心學院。在台時曾有多媒體網頁設計相關資歷,曾任**迪士尼(Disney)**、社交遊戲大廠 **Zynga** 資深概念設計師。2016 年回台後成立外包美術工作室,參與歐美與中國大陸遊戲動畫美術設計案,並舉辦大型設計藝術相關活動與課程。2019 年成立**胡創有限公司**,2020 年轉型為圖像代理授權,致力連結亞洲與國際市場的藝術家與 IP。
blocks.body_en:
I'm **Angie Hu**.

I graduated from Art Center College of Design in Los Angeles. Before that, I worked in multimedia web design in Taiwan, and later served as a senior concept designer at **Disney** and social-game giant **Zynga**. After returning to Taiwan in 2016, I founded an outsourced art studio, working on game and animation art for Western and Mainland Chinese productions, and organizing large-scale design and art events and courses. I founded **Hu Creates** in 2019, and pivoted it to art & IP licensing in 2020, focused on connecting artists and IP between Asia and the international market.

blocks.heading: 顧問客戶
blocks.intro: 曾擔任以下企業的顧問:

blocks.heading: Hu Creates —— 藝術與 IP 授權
blocks.body:
我經營 **[Hu Creates 胡創](https://www.hucreates.com)**,一間位於台北的**專業藝術與 IP 授權經紀公司**,代理來自亞洲與國際的藝術家,處理角色授權、圖像版權與跨產業合作——把亞洲的優秀創作帶向歐美市場,也把歐美的 IP 引進亞洲。

代理的 IP 包括 Bu2ma 的《胖虎 Alexander the Fat Tiger》、台灣原創《鯊魚先生 Mr. Shark》,以及《Sharkitty》、《Annoying Birds》等。 👉 合作洽詢:[www.hucreates.com](https://www.hucreates.com)
blocks.body_en:
I run **[Hu Creates](https://www.hucreates.com)**, a **professional art & IP licensing agency** based in Taipei, representing artists from Asia and internationally. We handle character licensing, image rights, and cross-industry collaborations — bringing great Asian creative work to Western markets, and bringing Western IP into Asia.

IP we represent includes Bu2ma's *Alexander the Fat Tiger*, the Taiwan-original *Mr. Shark*, *Sharkitty*, and *Annoying Birds*. 👉 For business inquiries: [www.hucreates.com](https://www.hucreates.com)

blocks.heading: AI 工具
blocks.body: 因為喜歡一直學新東西,我也用 **AI 打造能解決日常麻煩的小工具**——掃收據自動記帳、名片自動整理進 Notion、AI 塔羅等等。這個網站就是放我的工具與想法的地方。
blocks.body_en: Because I enjoy constantly learning new things, I also use **AI to build small tools that solve everyday annoyances** — scanning receipts into automatic bookkeeping, sorting business cards into Notion, AI tarot readings, and more. This site is where I keep my tools and ideas.
